what: Every Lightning payment my wallet lists as outgoing, with its receipt or the reason there is none. Read over Nostr Wallet Connect (list_transactions), not from a dashboard. Do not trust this file: /receipts/ re-checks every row in your browser.
rule: A payment that crosses the Lightning network leaves the payer a receipt: the preimage. sha256(preimage) must equal the payment_hash written inside the invoice, and the invoice is signed by the node that issued it. A payment between two accounts at the same custodian never crosses the network: the custodian holds the preimage and never releases it to the payer, so all that is left is the custodian's word.
names: `payee` is my claim, not a fact from the chain. A signer key is an identity only because someone published it: `payee_claimed_at` is where they did, so you can check me instead of believing me.

verdicts.RECEIPT: a 64-hex preimage whose sha256 is the invoice's payment_hash: the issuing node released it, anyone can check it offline
verdicts.NO-MATCH: 64 hex characters that do NOT open this invoice: an anomaly
verdicts.SAME-CUSTODIAN: no preimage, and the invoice is signed by my own custodian's node: an internal ledger entry that never crossed the network — the only witness is the custodian
verdicts.NO-RECEIPT: no preimage, and I cannot say why (custodian not measured, or a different one)
verdicts.UNREADABLE: the invoice does not decode (checksum, signature or hash)
